payload.claim: `_qualify_range`'s docstring says every input finding is "each recorded under `task_id` in the order given," but this diff removes the only thing that made that true. `findings = anchor(inputs, diff, read_head=partial(file_at, mirror, head))` on line 124 now lets a `file_at` raise propagate out of `anchor` before the function ever reaches its recording loop, so when any one finding's read raises, none of that range's findings get a `qualifications` row, not just the one whose read failed. The docstring still unconditionally promises completeness that the new exception-propagating design no longer provides.
